column44: Our team's campus-events bot kept double-booking rooms because it read calendar data before a sync finished. We added a debounce and a conflict check against a live lock table, then wrote regression tests that replay the exact race condition.
column45: Commuter students miss free food and last-minute event changes because updates are scattered across five club Instagram accounts. We want an AI agent that reads those accounts and texts a single daily digest to opted-in students.
column46: Two of us build the ingestion and scoring pipeline, one runs user interviews and prioritization, one owns the pitch and demo narrative, one designs the digest UI.
